query:
# How an endpoint holds the direct spouse (P26) triples: how many there are,
# and how many values are blank nodes, Wikidata items, or other IRIs (the
# query service gives unknown values as Skolem IRIs; a dump gives blank nodes).
# Used to compare candidate sources for the full run.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?triples)
       (SUM(IF(isBlank(?b), 1, 0)) AS ?blankValues)
       (SUM(IF(isIRI(?b) && STRSTARTS(STR(?b), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/"), 1, 0)) AS ?itemValues)
       (SUM(IF(isIRI(?b) && !STRSTARTS(STR(?b), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/"), 1, 0)) AS ?otherIriValues)
WHERE {
  ?a wdt:P26 ?b .
}
